newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Durango state apple production seen down.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Durango state apple production seen down.

text.p: Apple production in the Mexican state of Durango for 1996 is estimated at two million boxes, down from three million boxes in 1995, the Union of Durango Fruit Producers (UFD) said Thursday.
Each box contains about 20 kg of apples, which are sold primarily in Guadalajara, Aguascalientes and Mexico states.
The lower production, attributed to a freeze, will cost Durango state about 190 million pesos, Manuel Soto Hernandez, president of the growers union, told Reuters.
"The late winter freeze mainly affected the flowering, which is an important stage for the trees," Soto said.
